params.prompt: Create a portrait of ONE woman by combining two references. Take the AGE, SKIN and YOUTH from the FIRST reference image: a girl of exactly twenty — completely smooth taut dewy skin with no lines anywhere, full soft youthful cheeks, bright clear eyes with no shadows, soft full lips, the freshness of a village girl barely out of her teens. Take the FACIAL STRUCTURE and IDENTITY from the SECOND reference image: her long oval face shape, her wide-set almond eye placement and eye shape, her straight nose, her mouth shape, her high cheekbones — the same woman, recognisably. The result is that same woman at twenty years old: her bone structure, but a twenty-year-old's skin and softness. Jet-black hair centre-parted in one long thick braid, red-and-pink bandhani odhni over the head, small gold nathni on the LEFT nostril, red bindi, glass bangles on both wrists, fair wheat-golden Malwa complexion. Sharp photorealistic portrait, natural window light, plain neutral background, 85mm, front-facing, looking into the lens. No text anywhere.
